objective: Translate the validated BOJ MPM event-risk state into one causal, base-signal-agnostic new-entry blackout overlay. The overlay may suppress exposure increases but may never create long/short direction.

scope.applies_on: Pre-announced regular/scheduled BOJ Monetary Policy Meeting decision days only.
does_not_apply_on: Summary of Opinions release dates unless they are also the MPM decision date
MPM Minutes release dates unless they are also the MPM decision date
unscheduled/emergency MPMs in G1 because the date is not known under the same pre-event information set

causal_timing.blackout_start_rationale: Chosen only from official release-time metadata before any Stage-4 price/base-signal outcome test. For regular/scheduled MPM decision releases in 2016-2026 excluding the clearly unscheduled 2020-03-16 and 2020-05-22 meetings, n=84, earliest observed release=11:25, p05=11:39, median=12:00, p90=12:35, latest=13:18.
causal_timing.release_observation_rule: End time can begin counting only when the official BOJ policy decision / Statement on Monetary Policy publication is actually observed. Historical replays may inject the archived official publication timestamp as an event arrival at that timestamp; they may not expose it earlier.
causal_timing.release_not_observed_failsafe: Keep blackout active through the historical/current OSE day-session close.
causal_timing.future_time_guardrail: Do not use release-minus-10-minutes in live logic. Exact Statement release time is generally undecided before the MPM concludes.

position_mapping.input: Any independently generated base target-position or order intent.
inside_blackout: Any intent that increases absolute exposure is suppressed.
Any intent that reduces absolute exposure or closes a position passes through.
A reversal intent may reduce the current position to flat but the opposite-side opening leg is suppressed.
Existing filled positions are never force-closed solely because the blackout starts.
At 11:00, any remaining unfilled quantity of an outstanding order that would increase absolute exposure is cancelled.
Partially filled entry-increasing orders keep the filled position; only the remaining unfilled exposure-increasing quantity is cancelled.

cost_and_execution.suppressed_entry: No fill, hence zero commission/spread/slippage from the suppressed quantity.
cost_and_execution.cancelled_unfilled_entry: Assume zero exchange fill cost because no execution occurs; any broker-specific cancellation fee, if one exists in the future execution stack, must be included before Stage 7.
cost_and_execution.passed_through_orders: Inherit the independently preregistered base strategy fee/spread/slippage model. Stage 4 does not create a new price assumption.
cost_and_execution.forced_exit_cost: Not applicable; G1 does not force exits.

stage4_pass_definition: Exact causal mapping is frozen and machine-readable.
No opportunistic indicator voting or directional transformation is introduced.

engineering_selftest.purpose: Implementation QA only; not alpha or risk-utility evidence and not a substitute for an independent Stage-5 execution engine.
required_cases: Scheduled MPM exposure increase at/after 11:00 suppressed
Reversal inside blackout clamps to flat
Official policy-decision release ends blackout only after +20m
Summary/Minutes 08:50 publication does not end blackout
Missing release keeps blackout through day-session close
Outstanding exposure-increasing order is cancelled at 11:00
Historical metadata QA reproduces n=84 regular/scheduled release-time sample and no price outcomes are used

stage5_rule: Formal independent execution replay requires a second implementation/engine. Engineering selftest PASS cannot be labeled Stage-5 PASS.
stage6plus_rule: Do not evaluate economic utility, CPCV/PBO/DSR, cost stress, or forward performance until an independently validated base-entry process exists and a downstream evaluation protocol is separately frozen.
forbidden: Try alternate blackout starts such as 10:30/11:15/11:30 after seeing trading outcomes.
Try alternate post-release windows such as +10/+30/+60 after seeing trading outcomes.
Add forced exits, size cuts, stop widening or confidence changes to rescue G1.
Infer BOJ release time from market price/volume reaction.
Treat Summary of Opinions or Minutes 08:50 timestamps as the policy-decision release.
Use the overlay as a directional long/short signal.
Claim lower risk merely because fewer trades occur without measuring opportunity cost in later applicable stages.
